model.name: Pixal3D Shape 3x1.3B
model.description: Pixal3D turns one picture of an object into a detailed 3D mesh (GLB, geometry only) built in the picture's own camera, so that its visible side matches the image pixel for pixel. Its presets add SUPRA-Tex PBR textures (the former SUPRA-Tex model), after the Hi3D 3D Refiner or not; about a minute on a fast GPU for the shape.
